title: [de] Pure functional simplicity
excerpt: [de] A meditation on keeping architectures minimal and rejecting unnecessary runtime abstractions.
author: Elena Vance
imageAlt: [de] Minimalist architectural perspective with crisp geometric light and spiral geometry

body.text: [de] Every line of code added to a project represents liability. When static generation satisfies every business requirement, introducing a complex runtime server is an architectural misstep.
[de] By generating every permutation of language and route ahead of time, we achieve absolute predictability.
